$comment: Substrate-level swarm coordination lease record. Holder is the worker DID currently authoritative for the named scope. Mirrors the browser-local BroadcastChannel leader election from ADR-2605191603 across devices via MST. Authoritative per ADR-2605191638.

main.description: Cross-device swarm lease for an ameno scope (e.g. a firehose collection). At most one record per repo with the well-known rkey 'current' — write contention is resolved by MST CAS + L2 anchor monotonicity.

scope.description: What this lease governs. Examples: 'firehose:app.bsky.feed.post', 'autoRespond:ameno', 'briefDispatcher'. Convention: stable kebab-case identifier.

holderDid.description: DID currently holding the lease. Receivers MUST verify the record is authored by this same DID (PDS-side signature) before honouring the lease.

generation.description: Monotonically incrementing counter. Takeovers MUST publish generation > the previous record's generation, so concurrent claimants converge on a single winner.

issuedAt.description: Wall-clock at which the lease was first claimed.

expiresAt.description: Wall-clock at which the lease must be renewed or relinquished. Recommend issuedAt + 5 minutes.

renewedAt.description: Wall-clock at which the holder most recently renewed. Allowed to be equal to issuedAt.

computeMode.description: Holder's compute mode at lease time (local / daemon-a / daemon-b / custom). Advisory; lets followers reason about why the leader was chosen.

model.description: Holder's loaded model id, if relevant to the scope.

note.description: Free-form human-readable note (e.g. reason for takeover).
